patch_description: Crossover of the two best performers: the ILS with a multi-start seed pool (score 3921) and the richer neighborhood structure (2-opt segment reversal from the SA variant, Or-opt segment relocation from the pool variant). The new program builds a small pool of diverse greedy+polish seeds, then runs iterated local search with ruin-and-recreate perturbation, followed by a local search that combines 2-opt segment reversals, relocations, swaps, and Or-opt segment moves. Pool-based basin diversification plus richer move types should find lower-makespan schedules than either parent.
